=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:409 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When `details_url` is null, empty or not an Actions run URL, the unguarded jq `capture("/actions/runs/(?<id>[0-9]+)(/|$)")` makes `gate_sup_failed` come back empty, so the gate-sup block is skipped and no `PR_CHECKS_GATE_SUPERSEDED` line is logged.
  WHY: The check-run keeps blocking silently, which breaks the documented "one log line per evaluation" contract (lines 245-254) and makes the `status_read_failed` / `unknown` fallback unreachable; it fails closed, so merge safety does not regress. All four reviewers rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes it: on a non-match jq's capture produces no output rather than an error, `[ ] | first // "unknown"` yields "unknown", and the same idiom is already used at lines 115 and 337.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:376-385 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The supersede override also runs when `review / gate` reaches the required set through classic branch protection `required_status_checks.contexts` (built in `_pr_required_check_names_for_base`, lines 174-194), not only through the orchestrator default.
  WHY: An `ai-review/head-gate` commit status cannot satisfy a server-side required `review / gate` context. The local gate returns ok/outcome=superseded and the merge is then refused, or auto-merge waits forever, where today it refuses cleanly client-side. All three reviewers rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised the same point as a hardening suggestion and noted that no repository in this checkout meets the precondition.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator (lint_pr_body_auto_close step) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The PR head fails the tests-hooks-and-orchestrator check-run because of forbidden §21 auto-close references in the PR body ("Fixes #2734") and in commit message #2 ("resolved: #2734").
  WHY: These references would auto-close tracking issue #2734 on merge and stall the orchestrator project (reviewer rated it BLOCKER). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says this is not valid: the matched lines come from fixtures in tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py (lines 71, 235, 148), and the PR body only says "Closes .../issues/9212".
- (check-run signal, not mappable to a diff hunk):check-run tests-hooks-and-orchestrator on head 22de1e8, step `python3 tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py` (run 43042999949/job/130599454543) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The head is red. The `##[error][lint_pr_body_auto_close]` lines are expected output from `test_main_exit_codes` (tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py:458-506, whose fixtures use #2734), and the log ends before the PASS/FAIL summary.
  WHY: A red required check-run blocks the merge gate, and the failure cannot be explained by this diff because neither lint file is changed and collection_status was `timeout`. The editor must confirm whether it is inherited or flaky by re-running the job or comparing against the merge-base (reviewer rated it MAJOR).

- HARDENING: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:437 (`--arg ctx "${REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_CONTEXT:-ai-review/head-gate}"`)
  PROBLEM: The trusted status context comes from an env var, but scripts/review_head_gate.sh:5 pins it to the literal "ai-review/head-gate" and the comment at lines 372-375 says the rule is narrow on purpose.
  WHY: An inherited different value would let some other status relax the required check. Fix: pin `local gate_sup_status_ctx="ai-review/head-gate"` and update the header comment (line 243) and agents.d/9212-review-gate-supersede.md. Estimated 3 lines.

  PROBLEM: The override also runs when `review / gate` is required through classic branch protection `required_status_checks.contexts`.
  WHY: A commit status cannot satisfy that context on the server, so the gate logs superseded/ok and the merge then fails, where today it refuses with reason=required_checks_failed. main uses ruleset 25851281, which requires `lint` and `ai-review/head-gate` (docs/deploy-activation/activation-batch-protect-main.md:8). Fix: record the source and skip with reason=branch_protection_required. Estimated 6 lines.

The failures look inherited or flaky and should be re-run. "unmet (passes on base)" looks like an artefact of the acceptance gate.
